name: Vrindavan

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official Bhulekh homepage loaded; current Angular JavaScript referenced https://upbhulekh.gov.in/PublicBhuApi/api and https://upbhulekh.gov.in/PublicBhuApi/bhunaksha. No parcel response was requested from unsafe owner/ROR routes.

Official Bhu-Naksha viewer loaded. Current JavaScript/configuration exposed base URL https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver and public endpoints for levels, extent, plot-by-number, and exact-point lookup.

Anonymous level=1 lookup returned official district list including Mathura code 145; level=2 with codes=145 returned Sadar code 00764. The level=3 village lookup for codes=14500764 returned a backend 403 error.
Response was 0914500764, omitting the requested village segment; no village-level parcel GIS code was inferred.
For gisLevels=09,145,00764,124293 response returned zero bounds (xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax all 0.0) and gisCode 0914500764; treated as unresolved service routing, not absence.
Bounded anonymous plot-number probes using the official endpoint and candidate Mathura/Sadar GIS codes returned empty objects; no native parcel identity or geometry retained.
Bounded exact-point probe at [27.5700853432844,77.6720416719767] with candidate GIS code returned an empty object; this is not evidence of citywide absence.

Official dashboard lists Mathura/Sadar village 124293 as जैत with map linkage, verification, and georeferencing indicators all present; it reports three maps and is registry/coverage evidence, not parcel vector geometry.
